title: Forbidden-Total-Size Nim
summary: We consider a variant of Nim in which, for a fixed set $S$ of nonnegative integers, a move is forbidden if the total number of remaining stones belongs to $S$. This game coincides with normal-play Nim when $S=\emptyset$, and with misère Nim when $S=\{0\}$. In this paper, we focus in particular on the case where $S$ is the set of multiples of $d$, and show that simple criteria for determining the outcome can be obtained for $d=2,3,4$.
